about.text: A Levantine spread made by mashing well-aged, fermented shanklish with its mould and herbs into a strong, pungent paste, usually eaten with chopped tomato and onion and olive oil.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
strained fermented yoghurt formed into balls, rolled in za'atar or Aleppo pepper, dried and aged; fresh is soft, aged becomes hard and pungent; in Egypt made from fermented areesh/mesh
